_note: Cinyanja Grade 1 Teacher's Guide. Re-typeset 2026-11-17 from the authors' corrected manuscript (CINYANJA GRADE 1 TG CORRECTED.docx, saved 16 Nov), which now carries its own imprint, authors, foreword, Board and MD messages and preface. Ten units GAWO LOYAMBA … GAWO LA KHUMI over three terms (Temu 1-3); inside each unit the reading, word, comprehension and writing strands (GAWO LA KUWELENGA / MAU / MVETSO / KULEMBA) and the MUTU: n.n topics.
_note_localLabels: Cover, title page and running header in Cinyanja, the same words as the sibling LB (Maphunzilo a Pulayimale / Giredi 1); book type from the nyanja word list.

_note_cover: House-style cover (HOUSE-STYLE.md 3): centred masthead - eyebrow / big subject / accent rule / grade tag / book type / hero photo / authors / ZEPH logo, in the nyanja theme colour. The manuscript ships no cover page, so the hero photo is supplied here. Source art was 1066x1280 (154 DPI at B5 width, under the 300 DPI print floor); upscaled 4x with Real-ESRGAN (realesrgan-x4plus, -t 128) to 4264x5120 = 615 DPI at full B5 width, and stored as PNG rather than JPEG so the print master carries no compression artefacts.
_note_imprint: Copyright page laid out on the house model (Silozi G4 LB): the manuscript's own credits in its own Cinyanja labels, bold label over plain name, then publisher and address, ISBN with a dotted line, printer. The manuscript's ALEMBI: heading had made the engine end the imprint after the ISBN and set the contents page in the middle of it. Chishango 'Load' is the address typo for Chishango Road (as in every other ZEPH imprint). The cover-and-layout credit is the engine's house credit. ALEMBI: / Alembi are credit lines here, not the Authors section title, so they carry noPromote.

_note_asPara: Signatory names: bold paragraphs, not headings. 'Mau Ofunika Kudziwa:' (key words) was typed all-bold, so 208 of the 209 lines printed as large headings while their siblings (Mfundo Yophunzitsa:, Zida …:) are a bold label + plain text: one look for all, label bold only.
_note_setHeading2: Ten activity titles (Nchito n: …) and one Zocita line were typed as a plain/bulleted paragraph where 167 others are headings; two sub-topic lines were typed 'Mutu Waung'ono:' in lower case where 68 others are MUTU WAUNG'ONO: headings.

_note_fixes: Manuscript slips mended (numbering audit + read-through 2026-11-17): sub-topic 1.8.2 MVEKELO LA MALEMBO under Luso Lapadela 1.8.1.1 is 1.8.1 like its nine siblings; Luso 1.1.2.2 under sub-topic 1.2.1 is 1.2.1.2; 'MVEKELO IA' -> LA; a lower-case 'Dzina ndi Maina' sub-topic; 'MAYESO APAMAPETO AGAWO A GAWO' -> AGAWO as in the other nine units. Unit 10 carries three un-numbered lines: MAU OZUNGUZA LILIME (the second half of topic 1.5 ZILAPI NDI MAU OTEMBENUZA LILIME, so 1.5.2 / 1.5.2.1) and two repeats of MUTU: KUWELENGA MWALUSO / KUWELENGA MOKWEZA (topic 1.9.1 again, specific competences 2 and 3, so 1.9.1.2 and 1.9.1.3); the repeated topic line is dropped so the contents lists 1.9 once. _note_pictures: Three pictures the TG pointed to but did not carry, taken from the sibling LB (corrected LB docx of 16 Nov, the same activities): the story cards (LB image27) for Longosolani makhadi awa, the four picture cards (LB image29) for Longosolani zithunzi izi, and the Masilabe chart (LB image119) in place of the note (Ikani cithunzi kapena makadi a masilabe pano.). Each upscaled 4x with Real-ESRGAN (realesrgan-x4plus) to well over 300 DPI. _note_luso: Luso Lapadela lines in one look, the majority's (44): label and code bold, the competence plain. Fourteen had the code plain and seven were typed as capitalised headings (LUSO LAPADELA: 1.8.1.1 …).

_note_boxStripe: House rule for every book (QA gate).
_note_jpegQuality: Pictures stored as JPEG (quality 90, same pixels) instead of lossless, as the sibling LB.
_note_dropBreaks: Each strand (GAWO LA …) and some lessons open a fresh page; where the page before was under half full (30 of 53 breaks, some only 7-20% used), the break is dropped so the next strand follows on the same page (as the sibling LB). 18 Nov, user: do the same checks on the TG.

items.para: Fotokozani nkhani ya Kalulu ndi Nkhanu. Yankhani mafunso awa:
1. Kodi nkhani iyi ikamba za ciani?
**Yankho:** Nkhani iyi ikamba za Kalulu ndi Nkhanu.
**Yankho:** Tiphunzila kuti tisamanyoze anzathu cifukwa aliyense ali ndi luso lake.
Pangani ziganizo zokwanila pogwilitsa nchito mau awa:
**Yankho:** Ine nimapita ku sukulu tsiku lililonse.

_note_round1: Proofreading round 1 (return of 27 Nov 2026, 222 comments; zeph grade-1-cinyanja-tg round 1). Every 'Buku la Mphunzi tsamba N' now gives the page in the typeset LB as the proofreader marked it (edit, in page order; the new number is joined to 'tsamba' by a no-break space, so a reference already changed is never matched again); three notes cut short (p77, p103, p209 of the proof) and two refs the proofreader skipped (p136 -> 106, p243 -> 191) were read off the LB proof. Each MAYESO APAMAPETO AGAWO gives its LB page. Two activities without a Zocita get the one the proofreader wrote (Kalulu ndi Nkhanu questions, LB p19; sentences, LB p26). Names as marked: Chikumba (Mwana Wolemekezeka), Kalole (Mwana Wothandiza), Sankhani and Linda (name lists), Selita (LB p196, answers set under their questions); the rest of each lesson follows (and the Unit 3 test question on Mwana Wolemekezeka, as the LB test). Words: anapsya pansi -> anapsyela (swept, as marked; both stories), Thilayangolo -> moyenela where it means 'properly', amatembenuzila, amayendetsela, zimene, kukatunga madzi, Kodi tiphunzila ciani, Mau -> mau, LEMBANI MAU AWA MU MABUKU ANU, Nchito 3: Kusankha Malembo (as the LB), Zocita -> Citsanzo on p103. Not applied: Maliya -> Gezani in the Unit 6 test (the Mwana Woganiza story is Maliya's, in the TG and the LB, whose own test asks about Maliya); 'atachila' in the retyped Kalole story (the book spells it atacila).
